featured_reviews.name: Rajat Rajput
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very pleasant shopping experience at Reliance Smart. The store was well-organized, clean, and easy to navigate, which made finding products convenient and hassle-free. The variety of items available, especially in groceries and daily essentials, was impressive, and the quality met my expectations.
I would also like to appreciate the staff for being courteous and helpful. They were attentive and ready to assist whenever needed, which enhanced the overall experience. The billing process was smooth and efficient, with minimal waiting time.
However, there is still some scope for improvement in maintaining consistent stock availability for certain popular items. Apart from that, everything was excellent.
Overall, I am satisfied with my visit and would definitely recommend Reliance Smart to others for a comfortable and reliable shopping experience.

featured_reviews.review_text:

The items that you are looking for are generally available, but some you might find under combo offers only, or in large packs. The prices obviously are a little higher than D-Mart, and their offers don't entice me ever.

The best thing about Reliance is that it is less crowded than D-Mart, and you can shop peacefully. I guess it is the extra price you pay for. Their rewards system is a joke. In the last year and a half, we must have shopped closed to around Rs.13-15K, and all that we see in our rewards list is a reimbursement amount of Rs. 150.

featured_reviews.name: Anugraha Ghale
featured_reviews.review_text:
There’s something oddly calming about walking into a good supermarket. great supermarket inside Utopia Mall… spacious, well-organized, and full of variety. They have everything from fresh greens and salads to household essentials and kitchen items. I loved that they use paper bags for vegetables instead of plastic. Then the aisles opened up to everything else, dairy, grains, cleaning supplies, doormats, kitchen utensils, the whole rhythm of daily life, just sitting there on shelves.

The space itself was surprisingly open bright, The staff were kind and helpful, and even though they check your bill at the exit, it’s done politely and quickly. Good place to stop by even for cultural enrichment.

featured_reviews.name: Kuldeep Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
To D K Shop Owner,
I feel terrible about my visit to your shop today. This was the first time I went without my wife. We usually buy goods worth ₹5,000 to ₹10,000 every one or two months.
I always pay with GPay, but today I got the bank PIN and the GPay PIN mixed up. After three wrong attempts, my card got blocked. I called my wife and explained that it would take some time because my card was blocked.
My wife then said, "Please let me talk to the cashier; I will tell them that we will pay when we get home." But the cashier said you don't trust customers. You don't even offer home delivery.
We spend ₹70,000 to ₹80,000 at your shop every year. Don't you have any trust in us? Don't you people have any shame?

The owner Mr.Yogesh Deshpande is a very soft spoken gentleman who will guide you to choose the right thing not only for the value for money but treat ti your test buds too.

Their customer service and time saving efforts are worth appreciating. During various festivals they provide you pre order booking forms which ensures that you get an assured delivery of Authentic Good Maharashtrian Sweets & Snacks without any hassle.

The staff here is also quick & customer friendly too.

A decades old shop has recently started their second branch at Sunil Nagar Dombivli (East) too. And now the entire Deshpande family is service to customers only for authentic good quality snacks.

Hope the above matter will be taken seriously and immediate termination of both the checking staff standing near exit Lift. Also I request you to refund me an entire amount of Rs. 935/- paid by you and your checking staff has damaged all the 10 chocolates.

Manish Peshwani

featured_reviews.name: Riddhi Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
We purchased sugar-free dry fruit mithai from Hira Store. After bringing it home, we found white-colored worms in the sweets. Each piece had 2–3 worms in it. The most shocking part was that the mithai was sealed in plastic packaging, yet still contaminated.

Before buying, we specifically asked the staff whether the mithai was fresh, and the shop owner very sweetly assured us that it was fresh and asked us to go to the 1st floor. However, the quality was extremely poor.

When we went back to complain, they initially refused to give any compensation or penalty. Later, the owner started speaking very rudely to us. What was more disappointing was that they were not at all shocked after hearing about the worms, as if this was a common issue. It felt like they just wanted to end the matter quickly so that other customers in the shop would not notice.

After consuming the mithai, some members of our family suffered from stomach problems within one day.

I strongly advise everyone to ask proper questions before buying any sweets or products from this store, and if you do buy, check the product thoroughly before consuming.

Very disappointing and unacceptable experience.

featured_reviews.review_text: Very good place for vegetarians to get fresh grains and flour other than sauces, jams, masalas, mixes etc. My go-to place for good quality and fresh ingredients.

featured_reviews.name: Aniruddha Kavishwar
featured_reviews.review_text: Nearly 40 years old shop selling flour , pulses , rice , toiletories , tea , spices , and all sorts of dry snacks , dry fruits... Cleanliness of the shop and items is a speciality. People from all class rich to poor shop here. Newly the shop has introduced plastic items and vegitables , fruits too. Good place to purchase kirana . One can pay by using Credit / debit card . Prices are reasonable. Recommended for purchasing .

featured_reviews.name: Charuta Powale
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good general store for those who live in the neighborhood as the store is air conditioned and theitems are displayed on shelfs. You will find almost every general thing required for a household. They also have their own range of grains, pulses and snacks. Also, there is a vegetable vendor and a houseware shop in the premise. However, they do not offer discounts.
I buy daily stuff like tea, Maggi, biscuits, etc. from the store.

featured_reviews.name: Deepak Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: Been used to buying from chedda stores when I was in school some 38 years back, back then they started with all types of flour, now it is a modern air-conditioned place for grocery shopping, all the tasty and yummy snacks and flour are still sold....

featured_reviews.name: TheGreat V9
featured_reviews.review_text: Mostly the products are good ... But do check the expiry dates of epigamia yogurt , soy milk , Rasoi magic etc ... Also be very vigilent with the billing ... They said the new lot has been punched in the system and hence the bill for few items was more than MRP ...but we have had few experiences in past too.. also the quality of rice is not proper ... The new rice is sold at the price of old rice ...
